freshnessPolicies.rule: Evidence comes from a live provider or deployed-site run of the exact candidate source commit, in the run named by the ledger (run_id and source_sha match).
freshnessPolicies.reuseCondition: never reused: a new commit, a new run or a new deployment requires a new live run

freshnessPolicies.rule: Independent review evidence names the reviewed commit; it is fresh only for that commit, or for a later commit whose diff since the reviewed commit touches none of the reviewed paths, as stated by the reviewer.
freshnessPolicies.reuseCondition: not reused by the verifier; a re-review (or a reviewer's no-change attestation) is new evidence

freshnessPolicies.rule: Evidence comes from a deterministic test (unit, property, fixture replay, offline browser) whose result depends only on its declared inputs.
freshnessPolicies.reuseCondition: reusable within one run only when the test identity and the digest of every declared input (tested source paths, fixtures, dependency lock, baseline sha256) are unchanged and Dokimos reports the evidence Reusable:true with matching id, digest and immutable revision; never reused from an earlier rehearsal

evidenceContract.digest: sha256 of the evidence file bytes equals its entry in the independently pinned evidence manifest
evidenceContract.reuse: Reuse is permitted only when Dokimos reports the evidence Reusable:true with matching id, SHA-256 digest and immutable revision, and no invalidatedBy condition has occurred since; otherwise the check is re-run. Evidence from earlier rehearsals is never reused for this run.
evidenceContract.obligationEvidence: An obligation counts as verified only from an evidence file that passes every check above for its requirement and lists, under `obligations`, an entry {id: <the obligation's VPO id>, verification: PASS, tests: [{testId, outcome: passed}]} whose tests are bound to that obligation in this plan; the categories of those tests must cover every required category. A passing requirement-level result, or a test bound to a different obligation, verifies nothing.

exclusionPolicy.rule: A P0 requirement leaves scope only through an exclusion listed in curation/verification-plan.json whose approval is an authenticated operator change {requirement_id, action: exclude} in the pinned approvals file. It stays in the plan, marked excluded with its approval; any other exclusion fails compilation (V18).

categories.definition: Deterministic tests of one component in isolation (F# unit and property tests, illegal-transition and forged-history variants); no browser, provider or network.

Tests across a boundary between components or systems: producer/consumer contract tests, recorded-response provider contract tests, storage golden replay, dependency compatibility smoke, catalog verification.
The application exercised in a real browser engine (WebKit/Chromium via Percepta or Playwright), offline-fixture or deployed, including printed and rendered output.
Real requests against the authorized live provider (the GitHub test repository) in the candidate's own run, with independent re-reads; mocked or recorded responses never count.
Evidence that a security property holds: credential handling, least privilege, secret non-disclosure in logs, URLs, screenshots and artifacts.
Accessibility verification: automated accessibility report (axe), keyboard-only and focus checks, reduced motion, screen-reader semantics.
Evidence produced by a party independent of the implementing agent: an independent reviewer's record, or an acceptance job the implementer does not author, bound to the reviewed or deployed SHA.
